lines.en: I don’t believe in silver tongues, nor effervescent light.
lines.zh: 我不相信银舌,也不相信起泡的光。

lines.en: Or the songs unmatching eyes doth sing to the choirs of we sodomites.
lines.zh: 也不相信不配对之眼,唱给我们这些索多玛人的唱诗班的歌。

lines.en: So pretentious and unwilling — humble vice grip, hold me tight.
lines.zh: 如此做作、如此不愿——谦卑的虎钳,抱紧我。

lines.en: It will take more than a color wheel to eradicate this parasite.
lines.zh: 要根除这种寄生虫,一个色轮可不够。

lines.en: Are you lost again? Don’t worry. Dear, that’s how I love you best.
lines.zh: 你又迷路了吗?别担心。亲爱的,我最爱的正是这样的你。

lines.en: For when you’re safe, you never spend much time on what you keep repressed.
lines.zh: 因为你安全的时候,从不多花时间,去想你一直压抑的东西。

lines.en: These faded words might not find peace, but they’ll carve into your chest-
lines.zh: 这些褪色的字句或许找不到安宁,但它们会刻进你的胸膛——

lines.en: And remind you I won’t disappear.
lines.zh: 提醒你,我不会消失。

lines.en: I am simply here to rest.
lines.zh: 我只是在这里休息。

lines.en: - “Mommy”
lines.zh: ——署名「妈妈」

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei?
: ……Ami?

lines.en: : Were you having a nightmare? You normally stay really still when you’re asleep, but you were all...tossy and turny just now.
lines.zh: : 你做噩梦了吗?你睡着时通常一动不动,但你刚才一直在……翻来覆去。

lines.en: : I’m fine. But thanks for apparently always keeping a close eye on me while I’m passed out. That's not weird at all.
lines.zh: : 我没事。不过谢谢你,原来我昏睡时你一直在密切监视。这一点也不怪。

lines.en: : Of course. What else are nieces for?
lines.zh: : 当然。侄女不就是干这个用的吗?

lines.en: : Everything.
lines.zh: : 干什么都有用。

lines.en: : Well, not this one.
lines.zh: : 好吧,这个除外。

lines.en: : But anyway, now that you’re awake, would you mind explaining to me why there’s a girl here to visit you first thing in the morning?
lines.zh: : 但总之,既然你醒了,能不能解释一下,为什么一大早就有个女孩来拜访你?

lines.en: : Do I really need to explain to you why I’m so popular? Because this is a thing you should probably just know by now.
lines.zh: : 我真的需要解释我为什么这么受欢迎吗?因为这种事你现在应该早就知道了。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. Yes. Yes, I believe this might be something you will have to explain to me.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈。是的。是的,我想这也许正是你必须向我解释的事。

lines.en: : Don’t “ha ha ha” me. Just tell whoever it is that I’ll call them later.
lines.zh: : 别冲我「哈哈哈哈」。就告诉那个谁,说我晚点回电。

lines.en: : You most certainly will not. And stop trying to go back to sleep to get away from me.
lines.zh: : 你绝对不可以。还有,别想靠睡回笼觉躲开我。

lines.en: : Ugh, is it Makoto? Because that pout tells me it’s probably Makoto.
lines.zh: : 唉,是 Makoto 吗?因为你那个撇嘴告诉我,八成是 Makoto。

lines.en: : Are you expecting Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你在等 Makoto?

lines.en: : I’m never expecting anything...Things just always happen out of nowhere for me and I’m trying to piece together what the actual worst possible scenario is right now since whatever is going on is probably that.
lines.zh: : 我从来不等什么……事情总是莫名其妙地发生在我身上。我正在拼凑眼下真正最糟的可能是什么——因为不管在发生什么,多半就是那个。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re telling me! I didn’t even realize this girl was here for you until she held up a sign! Imagine my surprise when she just walked into the house!
lines.zh: : 你还跟我说呢!她举起一块牌子之前,我都不知道这女孩是来找你的!想象一下她就那么走进家门时我有多惊讶!

lines.en: : A...sign?
lines.zh: : 一块……牌子?

lines.en: : Yes! She hasn’t said a single word since she walked in and now she’s wandering around the house inspecting everything!
lines.zh: : 对!她进门以来一个字都没说过,现在正在屋里四处游荡,检查一切!

lines.en: : Well? What do you have to say about this?
lines.zh: : 那么?对此你有什么要说的?

lines.en: : I’m going back to sleep.
lines.zh: : 我回去睡觉。

lines.en: : Knock it off!
lines.zh: : 适可而止!

lines.en: : Ami, I don’t know how to handle this situation and any way I explain it is going to sound crazy.
lines.zh: : Ami,我不知道该怎么处理这个局面,而我无论怎么解释,听起来都会像疯话。

lines.en: : Well...can you just make her go away then? Because I’ve been trying for like fifteen minutes and she won’t budge. And I don’t know if I like the idea of suspicious children showing up here to hang out with you.
lines.zh: : 那……你能让她走吗?因为我已经试了大概十五分钟,她一动不动。而我不确定自己喜不喜欢可疑的小孩出现在这里、和你厮混这个主意。

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t like the idea of anyone showing up here to hang out with you. But this one is particularly weird and even younger than I thought you would have any interest in.
lines.zh: : 实际上,任何人出现在这里、和你厮混,我都不喜欢。但这个特别怪,而且比我以为你会产生兴趣的对象还要小。

lines.en: : Okay. Fine. But maybe don’t let strangers into the house anymore if you don’t want them walking around inspecting our stuff.
lines.zh: : 好。行。但如果你不想陌生人四处走动检查我们的东西,或许就别再放陌生人进家门了。

lines.en: : Well forgive me for not realizing that was a thing I had to worry about! The heck is going on with this neighborhood nowadays?!
lines.zh: : 好好好,原谅我没意识到这是我需要担心的事!如今这个街区到底是怎么了?!

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么?

lines.en: : Nao, what are you doing here?
lines.zh: : Nao,你来这里干什么?

lines.en: : No. This is not a thumbs-up situation.
lines.zh: : 不。这不是竖大拇指的场合。

lines.en: : Yes, that’s more like it.
lines.zh: : 对,这才像话。

lines.en: So...it appears that the newest character in my life has decided to show up at my door significantly ahead of schedule.
lines.zh: 所以……看来,我人生中的最新角色,决定大幅提前登门拜访了。

lines.en: Like...half a decade ahead of schedule. And I have no idea why or how.
lines.zh: 提前了……大概五年。而我完全不知道为什么,也不知道怎么做到的。

lines.en: : Why? How?
lines.zh: : 为什么?怎么做到的?

lines.en: : I have no idea, Ami. I was literally just wondering that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道,Ami。我字面意义上正想这个问题。

lines.en: : Who even is this? I have never seen this girl in my life. Why do you know her name? How are you acquainted with her? Just what exactly have you been doing behind my back?
lines.zh: : 这到底是谁?我这辈子从没见过这个女孩。你为什么知道她的名字?你们怎么认识的?你背着我的这段时间,究竟都在干什么?

lines.en: : It’s a long story.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: : Sensei, when you asked me to give you space, I knew you’d use it to make some stupid decisions. But this is not the direction I thought you’d take that in.
lines.zh: : Sensei,你让我给你空间的时候,我就知道你会拿它去做些愚蠢的决定。但我没想到你会把那份空间用在这个方向上。

lines.en: : Again, I have no idea why this is happening. Nao shouldn’t even know where I live. And she definitely shouldn’t be wandering around Kumon-mi unsupervised.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,我不知道为什么会这样。Nao 本不该知道我住哪。她更不该无人看管地在 Kumon-mi 到处游荡。

lines.en: : Nao? What’s her family name?
lines.zh: : Nao?她姓什么?

lines.en: : She doesn’t have one. Well...at least not one anybody knows yet.
lines.zh: : 她没有姓。嗯……至少还没有任何人知道。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是吗……

lines.en: : And how old is she exactly?
lines.zh: : 那她到底多大?

lines.en: : There’s no way of-
lines.zh: : 没有办法——

lines.en: : Oh no.
lines.zh: : 哦不。

lines.en: : For what?!
lines.zh: : 写的什么?!

lines.en: : Now, before she answers this question, I’d like to make it known that my relationship with Nao can barely even be called a relationship in the first place. She’s more of a-
lines.zh: : 现在,在她回答这个问题之前,我想声明:我和 Nao 的关系,起初就连「关系」都算不上。她更像一个——

lines.en: : You were saying?
lines.zh: : 你刚说到哪?

lines.en: : She’s more of some girl that Kaori is looking after that I just happened to get acquainted with through her.
lines.zh: : 她更像某个 Kaori 照看的女孩,我只是恰好通过 Kaori 认识了她。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. That completely explains why she’s asking you to sit on her.
lines.zh: : 哦,好。这完全解释了,她为什么在请你坐到她身上。

lines.en: : I think that’s code for babysitting. You need to remember that her mentor is Kaori and that sort of thing can have a negative impact on a young, impressionable girl.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那是「看孩子」的暗号。你要记住,她的导师是 Kaori,而那种东西对一个年轻、易受影响的女孩,会产生负面影响。

lines.en: : I know. I wasn’t being sarcastic.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我没在讽刺。

lines.en: : So...Nao-chan...are you Miss Kaori’s...cousin or something? Because you’re clearly not a niece. I have niece senses and would be able to detect that.
lines.zh: : 那么……Nao 酱……你是 Kaori 小姐的……表亲之类的吗?因为你显然不是侄女。我有侄女雷达,能探测出来。

lines.en: : Well, that doesn’t help at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这毫无帮助。

lines.en: : It’s equally unhelpful that all of her signs appear to be remotely suggestive.
lines.zh: : 同样没帮助的是,她所有的牌子看上去都隐隐带暗示。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like she’s writing them herself. It looks like she’s flipping through the pages to find stuff that was already written down. She might not have an answer to everything.
lines.zh: : 嗯,又不是她自己写的。看起来她是在翻页,找出早已写好的内容。她未必每个问题都有答案。

lines.en: : Well, we can all be thankful that Kaori decided to include the extremely valuable signs of “old enough” and “25%% off wieners.”
lines.zh: : 那么,我们都该感谢 Kaori,决定加入「年纪够大」和「小香肠七五折」这两块极有价值的牌子。

lines.en: : Stop looking so proud and go find your guardian. I’m not a babysitter.
lines.zh: : 别摆出那么骄傲的表情,去找你的监护人。我不是保姆。

lines.en: : Maybe Kaori just felt a little bad since she works all the time? Nao-chan would probably get lonely cooped up in that apartment all by herself. It only makes sense that she’d send her to a friend’s house.
lines.zh: : 也许 Kaori 只是觉得有点过意不去,毕竟她总在工作?Nao 酱独自被关在那间公寓里,大概会孤单。把她送到朋友家,合情合理。

lines.en: : I should say that I feel a little relieved to find out that this is why you’ve been hanging out with Kaori lately, though. She’s really pretty and I got jealous and...I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 不过我得说,得知你最近和 Kaori 来往是这个原因,我松了口气。她真的很漂亮,我吃醋了,而且……对不起。

lines.en: : Why are you being so mature? It’s weird.
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然这么成熟?好怪。

lines.en: : This is what you want, isn’t it? If I keep suffocating you-
lines.zh: : 这正是你想要的,不是吗?要是我继续让你窒息——

lines.en: : PS: Please buy her — wait, why is Kaori putting the “PS” at the top? Isn’t that supposed to go on the bottom?
lines.zh: : 附言:请给她买——等等,为什么 Kaori 把「附言」写在开头?那不是应该放在末尾吗?

lines.en: : Probably the same reason she says goodbye instead of hello- because she’s a lunatic.
lines.zh: : 大概和她道别不说你好是同一个原因——因为她是个疯子。

lines.en: : Greetings, Friendburger. I have to cream all day, so please sit on Nao-chan.
lines.zh: : 问候你,朋友汉堡。我今天要打一整天奶油,所以请坐到 Nao 酱身上。

lines.en: : And if she tries to use your mug, don’t let her. She is a mug monster...that means she is like a monster, but with mugs.
lines.zh: : 还有,如果她想用你的马克杯,别让她。她是马克杯怪……意思是,她像怪物,但配马克杯。

lines.en: : PS: Please buy her new body fabric. I will pay you back with gum.
lines.zh: : 附言:请给她买新的身体布料。我会用口香糖还你。

lines.en: : Thanks for reading all of that, Ami. My eyes aren’t what they used to be.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你念完这一切,Ami。我的眼睛大不如前了。

lines.en: : It looks like you’re going to have to take Nao-chan shopping, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 看来,你得带 Nao 酱去买东西了,Sensei。

lines.en: : What? Why? I wanted to exercise my new freedom and do other stuff today. I shouldn’t be bogged down by babysitting Kaori’s surrogate daughter.
lines.zh: : 什么?为什么?我今天想行使我的新自由,干点别的事。我不该被看管 Kaori 的代养女儿拖住。

lines.en: : But think of all the gum you’ll get.
lines.zh: : 可想想你能拿到多少口香糖。

lines.en: : Ami, can you stay here with Nao for a second while I go call her mother?
lines.zh: : Ami,我去给她母亲打电话,你能在这儿陪 Nao 一会儿吗?

lines.en: : Sure, but if our mugs start disappearing, you’re going to be the one on the hook to buy more. You were warned, Sensei. You know what you’re getting into.
lines.zh: : 当然,但要是我们的马克杯开始失踪,负责买新的就是你。警告过你了,Sensei。你知道自己会摊上什么。

lines.en: : I think we can live without a few mugs, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我想,少几个马克杯我们照样能活,多谢关心。

lines.en: : Good-
: Explain yourself.
lines.zh: : 给我解释清楚。

lines.en: : I am Kaori! I came to life when I exited my mothermom and now spend my reverse-nights feeding small creatures to a large creature who-
lines.zh: : 我是 Kaori!我从母妈的体内出来时获得了生命,如今把反夜用来给一个大型生物投喂小型生物,那个生物——

lines.en: : No, I mean explain why you sent Nao to my house.
lines.zh: : 不,我是说,解释你为什么把 Nao 送到我家。

lines.en: : Nao-chan requires four hours of social interaction each day in order to grow into a healthy bird!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱每天需要四小时的社交互动,才能长成一只健康的鸟!

lines.en: : She is a human.
lines.zh: : 她是人类。

lines.en: : Yes, a human bird. What kind of gum do you like?
lines.zh: : 对,人类鸟。你喜欢什么口香糖?

lines.en: : Kaori, how did you even get my address? You’ve never been to my house.
lines.zh: : Kaori,你到底怎么拿到我的地址的?你从没来过我家。

lines.en: : Yes!
: Yes what?
lines.zh: : 对什么?

lines.en: : Address!
lines.zh: : 地址!

lines.en: I feel like this is going to be a long conversation.
lines.zh: 我感觉,这将会是一场漫长的对话。

lines.en: : Okay...Listen up, Nao-chan. I’m going to level with you here.
lines.zh: : 好……听着,Nao 酱。我要跟你说实话了。

lines.en: : Sensei is my uncle and my guardian. And he doesn’t know this yet, but he’s also going to be the father of my children one day and we’re going to raise a beautiful family together.
lines.zh: : Sensei 是我的舅舅,也是我的监护人。他自己还不知道,但他有一天也会成为我孩子的父亲,我们会一起养育一个美好的家庭。

lines.en: : Don’t look so disgusted. You shouldn’t even know the real world implications of that yet. And the only reason I’m telling you in the first place is so you don’t try anything funny.
lines.zh: : 别一脸嫌弃。你甚至还不该知道那在现实世界意味着什么。而我之所以告诉你,唯一的原因就是免得你搞小动作。

lines.en: : Sensei is really important to me, okay? And I get that you’re just a little girl who doesn’t really understand how the world works or whatever yet, but...hands off.
lines.zh: : Sensei 对我真的很重要,好吗?我知道你只是个小女孩,还不真正理解世界如何运转之类的,但是……别碰他。

lines.en: : Really? Just like that?
lines.zh: : 真的吗?就这么答应了?

lines.en: : Huh...Everyone else always puts up a fight.
lines.zh: : 咦……其他人总是要反抗一下的。

lines.en: : Well, I guess you can’t really put up a fight in the first place since you can’t talk. But just know that I’ll be watching you, okay? I don’t fully trust you yet. Especially not after storming into my house.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我想你本来也反抗不了,毕竟你不会说话。但你给我记住,我会盯着你的,好吗?我还没完全信任你。尤其是在你闯进我家之后。

lines.en: : You are really cute, though. I’ll give you that much. And you’ve got heterochromia, just like Miss Kaori-
lines.zh: : 不过你真的很可爱。这一点我承认。而且你有异色瞳,和 Kaori 小姐一样——

lines.en: : ...wait a minute.
lines.zh: : ……等一下。

lines.en: : Your eyes seem kind of familiar...
lines.zh: : 你的眼睛,好像有点眼熟……

lines.en: : Isn’t that...the same color as mine?
lines.zh: : 那是不是……和我的眼睛一个颜色?

lines.en: : And isn’t the other one the same color as-
lines.zh: : 而另一只,是不是和——

lines.en: : Hm?
: What? What do you want from me?
lines.zh: : 怎么?你想从我这里要什么?

lines.en: : Are you...
lines.zh: : 你是在……

lines.en: : Are you asking me to pat your head?
lines.zh: : 你是在让我摸摸你的头吗?

lines.en: : Ugh...fine. But if I do this, you have to swear you’ll leave Sensei alone, okay?
lines.zh: : 唉……行吧。但我这么做,你就得发誓离 Sensei 远点,好吗?

lines.en: : There you go. Is this what you wanted?
lines.zh: : 好啦。这就是你想要的吗?

lines.en: : You know, Nao-chan...I think I might be starting to kind of like you! Not being able to talk means you can’t tease me or make fun of me for anything! And people have been doing that a lot lately.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,Nao 酱……我想我可能开始有点喜欢你了!不会说话,意味着你没法撩我,也没法嘲笑我!而最近大家老是这么干。

lines.en: : Do you like me too?
lines.zh: : 你也喜欢我吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, I bet you do. I bet you do.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我打赌你喜欢。我打赌你喜欢。

lines.en: : Who’s a good girl? Who’s a good girl? Nao-chan’s a good girl, isn’t she? Isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 谁是好孩子?谁是好孩子?Nao 酱是好孩子,是不是?是不是?

lines.en: : Yeah...you love that, don’t you? Don’t you, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 是啊……你喜欢这个,对吧?对吧,Nao 酱?

lines.en: : How ‘bout there? Is that good too? You want me to rub your ears? Yeah? Yeah?
lines.zh: : 这里怎么样?这样也舒服吗?要我揉揉你的耳朵吗?是吗?是吗?

lines.en: : Ahem...
lines.zh: : 咳嗯……

lines.en: : Sensei! It’s not what it looks like!
lines.zh: : Sensei!不是你看到的那样!

lines.en: : I see...so Kaori’s not going to be home until really late and Nao-chan isn’t ready to take care of herself yet.
lines.zh: : 我明白了……所以 Kaori 很晚才回家,而 Nao 酱还没到能照顾自己的年纪。

lines.en: : Right. And since Yuki’s going to be at the bar all day and Kaori doesn’t have any other friends, I wound up being the next in line.
lines.zh: : 对。而 Yuki 一整天都在酒吧,Kaori 又没有别的朋友,于是我顺位成了下一个。

lines.en: : Well, what are you gonna do? You can’t just send her off on her own. But you seemed so excited to finally have some Ami-less time for whatever weird reason you actually want Ami-less time.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那你打算怎么办?总不能让她自己乱跑。可你之前看起来那么兴奋,终于能有不含 Ami 的时光——不管你想要不含 Ami 的时光的理由有多怪。

lines.en: : Easy. I’m going to make you watch her instead while I go off and be an adult somewhere.
lines.zh: : 简单。我让你替我看着她,而我去别处当个成年人。

lines.en: : What?! Why me?!
lines.zh: : 什么?!为什么是我?!

lines.en: : Well, to start off, it looked like you two were really getting along just a minute ago.
lines.zh: : 首先,一分钟前你们俩看起来相处得相当融洽。

lines.en: : That’s only because you won’t let me get a pet and Nao-chan is the closest thing we’ve ever had to that!
lines.zh: : 那只是因为你不让我养宠物,而 Nao 酱是我们有过的最接近宠物的东西!

lines.en: : We don’t have Nao. She’s Kaori’s responsibility after today, not ours.
lines.zh: : 我们没有 Nao。今天之后,她是 Kaori 的责任,不是我们的。

lines.en: : What if we adopt her?
lines.zh: : 要是我们领养她呢?

lines.en: : What? You wanted her out of the house less than twenty minutes ago. What changed?
lines.zh: : 什么?二十分钟前你还想让她滚出家门。什么变了?

lines.en: : Everything. Everything changed. And now I can’t live without her.
lines.zh: : 一切。一切都变了。而现在我离不开她了。

lines.en: : Can we keep her? Please?
lines.zh: : 我们能留下她吗?求你了?

lines.en: : Ask me again at the end of the day when you’re done babysitting her.
lines.zh: : 等你今天看完她,再问我一次。

lines.en: : Sensei, I have work in less than an hour. Not to mention how I’m still on thin ice from the dressing room thingy.
lines.zh: : Sensei,不到一小时我就要上班了。更别说我还因为试衣间那件事,处境如履薄冰。

lines.en: : Just take Nao-chan to the mall or something. That way, you can keep her occupied and find her clothes.
lines.zh: : 带她去商场之类的吧。这样你既能让她有事做,又能给她找衣服。

lines.en: : If all she has is that oversized hoodie, she’s going to overheat. This summer’s been the hottest on record and if Nao-chan dies now, we’ll never get to see how she looks when she’s all grown up.
lines.zh: : 她要是只有那件过大的连帽衫,会热出事的。今年夏天是有记录以来最热的,而如果 Nao 酱现在死了,我们就永远看不到她长大后是什么样子了。

lines.en: : It’s really interesting how your heart can be in both the right place and the wrong place at the same time.
lines.zh: : 真有趣,你的心居然能同时处于正确的位置和错误的位置。

lines.en: : You don’t know the half of it.
lines.zh: : 这还只是冰山一角。

lines.en: : Hah...Nao, do you want to go the mall?
lines.zh: : 哈……Nao,你想去商场吗?

lines.en: : Wow...Kaori got really specific with these sign choices, didn’t she?
lines.zh: : 哇……Kaori 这些牌子选项准备得可真具体,是吧?

lines.en: : A mall is like...a big building where you can buy anything you want and...socialize with other people who are there to shop, I guess?
lines.zh: : 商场就像……一栋大建筑,你想买什么就能买什么,还可以……和同样来购物的人社交,我猜?

lines.en: : Well, I guess that settles it then. Don’t have too much fun without me, you two.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我猜就这么定了。你们俩别玩得太开心,把我忘了。

lines.en: : And remember what I told you, Nao-chan...
lines.zh: : 还有,记住我跟你说过的话,Nao 酱……

lines.en: : Hands off.
lines.zh: : 别碰他。

lines.en: : Bye! Time to get ready for work!
lines.zh: : 拜!该准备上班了!

lines.en: : Don’t mind her. She’s broken.
lines.zh: : 别理她。她坏掉了。

lines.en: I ask Nao to remain on the couch while I head back into my room to get dressed.
lines.zh: 我请 Nao 在沙发上等着,然后回房间换衣服。

lines.en: When I return, I notice that all of our cabinets are open and all of our mugs are gone.
lines.zh: 等我回来,发现我们家所有的橱柜都开着,所有的马克杯都不见了。

lines.en: Nao’s affection has increased to [nao_love]!
lines.zh: Nao 的好感度提升到了 [nao_love]!
